page.title: Settings
page.subtitle: Configure AI video, Chrome, scene density, and the task queue.

settings.kenBurnsDesc: Enable pan/zoom on each image in the slideshow.
settings.kenBurnsOnPrepareDesc: Applies only while preparing. On: prebake a Ken Burns clip as each image is saved, when Ken Burns is also on. Off: prepare only saves images; creating the video still follows the Ken Burns option.
settings.transitionsDesc: Enable xfade transitions between images; off uses hard cuts.

chrome.hint: How to keep Chrome windows in the background during automation.

settings.chromeOffscreenDesc: On: park windows off-screen when running in the background. Off: keep windows visible normally.
settings.scenePromptConcurrencyDesc: How many Chrome profiles run scene-prompt LLM chunks at once (1–8). Value 1 = sequential. Uses profiles with the default text LLM ticked in LLM Content, up to as many as exist.
settings.metaTabsPerProfileDesc: How many image windows run at once on each Chrome profile with Meta ticked (1–5), i.e. how many prompts one Meta account gets at the same time. More is faster, but draws more attention to the account and uses more RAM. Default 3.
settings.sceneDensity: Max duration per scene (seconds) — system default. YouTube channels can still override per channel.
settings.concurrencyHint: Number of queue jobs that can run at once. Value 1 = sequential (next job waits for the previous to finish).
settings.removeWatermarkDesc: On: after a Flow thumbnail succeeds, regenerate it once through Meta (the Flow image attached as reference) with the prompt below, without resizing, and use that image as the thumbnail. If this step fails the Flow image is kept.
settings.verboseLogsDesc: On: log ffmpeg/progress/each clip as today. Off: only step names and durations.
settings.enableUpdateTranscriptDesc: On (true): checks conditions (Japanese language, captions enabled) to rewrite transcript with LLM. Off (false): skips transcript update completely.
settings.providersDesc: Pick the LLM / browser tool and the Chrome profile for each kind of job. Applies to every pipeline and the Prompt page playground. Changes save right away.

format.intro: File type ElevenLabs returns, as codec_sample-rate_bitrate. Applies to every voice.

items.mp3_44100_128: MP3 44.1 kHz, 128 kbps. Default; good enough for YouTube, small files.
items.mp3_44100_192: MP3 44.1 kHz, 192 kbps. Slightly crisper, ~50% larger. Requires Creator tier or above.
items.mp3_22050_32: MP3 22 kHz, 32 kbps. Very small but low quality; for quick tests only.
items.pcm_24000: PCM 24 kHz, uncompressed. Original quality, very large files.
items.pcm_44100: PCM 44.1 kHz, uncompressed. Very large files. Requires Pro tier or above.

format.tierNote: On the FREE plan, use mp3_44100_128.

hint.pitchScale: 0 = original; negative is deeper, positive is higher.
